title: VITA-QinYu：用于角色扮演和歌唱的富有表现力的口语语言模型
summary: VITA-QinYu 是首个支持角色扮演和歌唱生成的端到端口语语言模型。采用混合语音-文本范式，结合多码本音频令牌，实现丰富的副语言表示。在角色扮演和歌唱基准上超越现有模型，同时保持最先进的对话准确性和流畅性。开源代码和模型。
summary_en: VITA-QinYu is the first expressive end-to-end spoken language model supporting role-playing and singing. It uses a hybrid speech-text paradigm with multi-codebook audio tokens for rich paralinguistic representation, outperforming peers on role-playing and singing benchmarks while maintaining state-of-the-art conversational accuracy.
